Thanks for taking the time to fill out this bug report!

Before continuing, please make sure there isn't already a similar issue on [the issue tracker](https://github.com/raik-fr/Tapetum/issues). If there is, consider adding your information there instead.

**What happened?**
Also tell us what you expected to happen. Please provide reproduction steps: what did you do to trigger the bug?

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Log output**
Please upload a client log file by dragging and dropping it into this section. Usually found at `.minecraft/logs/latest.log`. Please do not upload a compressed (`.log.gz`) file — the log file tells us important information like other installed mods and errors, so it's important to include it.

**Minecraft Version**
ex. Minecraft 1.16.5

**Tapetum Shaders Version**
ex. tapetum-1.16.5-0.1.0.jar

**Operating System**
What is your Operating System?
ex. Windows 10

**GPU**
Please write the vendor and model of your GPU.
ex. Nvidia GeForce RTX 2070

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here. If you're comfortable reading logs and think there's an especially relevant section, feel free to paste it in a code block here — that's not required, though.
